benchmark_data_readiness.completion_limit: Readiness substrate, CLRS executable smoke, upstream-baseline comparators, deterministic patch comparators, and public-safe negative nanoGPT trial only; not Ember governed improvement execution and not overall completion.

external_benchmark_receipts.completion_limit: Imported prior benchmark/access receipts are not Ember wins and not overall baseline completion.

architecture_growth_keystone_sota.field_relevance: A win must beat fixed-size, random-growth, and same-axis architecture or kernel comparators under deletion-tested controls.

data_efficiency_sota.field_relevance: A win must improve capability per token or compute against current data-efficiency anchors without cross-task laundering.

ember_cli_runtime_reproducibility.field_relevance: A win must prove create, run, resume, inspect, verify, package, and replay behavior under interrupted and failed experiments.

ember_goal_mode_control.field_relevance: A win must reject premature completion and scope drift better than ordinary checklist or chat-transcript control.

field_level_contribution_threshold.field_relevance: A win must name the exact external claim that would be field-level and the falsifiers that would downgrade it to local progress.

local_agentic_research_sota.field_relevance: A win must improve local autonomous research selection, execution, receipt parsing, and no-recompute governance against agentic research baselines.

reproducibility_publication_surface.field_relevance: A win must produce a clean replayable public/private baseline surface with citations, manifests, line-ending receipts, and remote proof.

self_improvement_loop_sota.field_relevance: A win must show the improvement loop beats an external/local agentic ML research loop under equal budget and external receipts.

single_4090_ge_1b_foundation_ceiling.field_relevance: A win must establish a credible days-scale >=1B active-parameter training or pretraining-equivalent path on one RTX 4090-class GPU.

training_efficiency_sota.field_relevance: A win must beat the strongest practical training-speed/time-to-target ruler under comparable accounting.

private_repo.artifact_identity_policy: sha256 over substantive baseline files excluding self-referential lock/proof receipts

public_repo.artifact_identity_policy: sha256 over substantive baseline files excluding self-referential lock/proof receipts
